shouldFix.title: The durable recording carries only the Codex v5 advisory and drops the three Claude advisory identifiers
location: Stage A Claude verdict row, lines 39-45
shouldFix.finding: The draft digest-pins the Claude v5 ACCEPT verdict at edae073303d893901c7ec7ff7dc6632a86ca8c8c31dbdac290939d56abce44e0, but Decision item 4 says only 'Advisory CODEX-G31-V5-ADV-1 travels as honesty work.' The pinned Claude verdict has three advisories: CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-1, CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-2, and CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-3. CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-2 and CODEX-G31-V5-ADV-1 measure the same purpose-field inaccuracy, so they are one substantive advisory class, but the draft neither names that de-duplication nor preserves the Claude identifier. CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-1 (the undispositioned prior claimVerbatim advisory) and CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-3 (registerRowNote's two-version-stale predecessor emphasis) are distinct and absent entirely.
evidence: The frozen Claude v5 review has empty blockers and shouldFix arrays and exactly three advisory objects with ids CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-1, CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-2, and CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-3.
The frozen Codex v5 review has zero blockers, zero SHOULD-FIX, and one advisory, CODEX-G31-V5-ADV-1; its substance overlaps Claude ADV-2.

Immediate adopted D-207 explicitly carries both Stage A Claude advisories by identifier. The same-class precedent adopted around D-136 requires naming both reviewer identifiers and declaring the de-duplication rather than silently retaining only one provenance lane.

D-208 item 4 uses the corpus's operative phrase 'travels as honesty work,' so this is not a draft that uniformly relies on the pinned verdict files without an advisory recital; it selectively recites one lane.
shouldFix.impact: The omission does not invalidate dual ACCEPT 0/0, change the selected v5 occupancy, alter readiness, or create authority, so it is not MUST-FIX. It does make the durable coordinator record incomplete and causes two distinct honesty items plus one independent provenance identifier to disappear at the exact act that claims to carry review honesty work.
shouldFix.repair: Rewrite Decision item 4 to say that CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-1, CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-2 / CODEX-G31-V5-ADV-1 (one shared advisory class), and CLAUDE-G31-V5-ADV-3 travel as non-gating honesty work. A reasoned explicit disposition of any item is also sufficient; silent omission is not.
shouldFix.doesNotRequire: No change to v5, its verdicts, file 08, COORD, G31/G32, required-now, SATISFIED standing, Class A, fixture bytes, qualification, D9, or implementation authority is needed.
